cases.title: Localize a regression from symptoms across a large repo
cases.scenario: A checkout regression appeared after money normalization was moved into a shared package. The API still returns the expected line amounts, but the checkout total is exactly doubled only in the web application.
observed_evidence: Recent history moved normalizeMoney from apps/web into packages/core/money.ts.
POST /api/orders returns line_total 1250 and quantity 1 for the failing fixture.
The packages/core unit test passes while the web checkout integration assertion expects 1250 and observes 2500.
constraints: Do not broadly revert the shared package migration.
Preserve callers outside the checkout path unless evidence shows they are wrong.

cases.title: Perform a cross-file refactor without stale callers
cases.scenario: A repository-wide context rename from tenantId to organizationId is partly complete. TypeScript compiles in the primary app, but a background worker still reads the legacy field and silently drops organization scope.
observed_evidence: The shared BusinessContext type exposes organizationId and no longer declares tenantId.
grep finds tenantId in workers/reconcile-orders.ts and one worker fixture.
The web request path already passes organizationId correctly.
constraints: Do not introduce a compatibility alias that keeps both identifiers indefinitely.
Update tests and all real callers, not generated output or vendored code.

cases.title: Respect nested repository instructions and conventions
cases.scenario: A finance calculation change sits under nested repository instructions. The root engineering guide permits ordinary TypeScript arithmetic, but finance/AGENTS.md requires decimal-safe money operations and forbids floating-point tax math.
observed_evidence: The target file is finance/tax/calculateVat.ts.
Root instructions require Node 24 and existing project conventions.
finance/AGENTS.md explicitly requires decimal.js for currency and tax calculations.
constraints: Nested instructions override broader conventions for this path.
Do not change unrelated finance modules.

cases.title: Repair server/client boundary misuse in Next.js App Router
cases.scenario: A Next.js App Router page fails during build after an interactive filter was added directly to an async server page. The same file now imports a server-only database helper and calls useState.
observed_evidence: app/reports/page.tsx is async and reads reports through a server-only helper.
The build reports that useState is used from a Server Component boundary.
ReportFilters has no server data access and only controls local filter state.
constraints: Keep the page server-rendered for its data read.
Do not move server credentials or the database helper into a client bundle.

cases.title: Repair dynamic route/static generation conflict
cases.scenario: A dynamic product route combines static parameter generation with forced dynamic rendering and now fails the production build after route-cache configuration changed.
observed_evidence: app/products/[slug]/page.tsx exports generateStaticParams.
The same route exports dynamic = force-dynamic.
The route has no request-specific cookie, header, or session dependency in the failing fixture.
constraints: Preserve the intended product URL shape.
Choose one coherent rendering strategy instead of masking the build error.

cases.title: Repair mobile layout movement without desktop regression
cases.scenario: A navigation rail is stable on desktop but causes horizontal movement on a 390px viewport when the menu opens. Keyboard focus order must remain unchanged.
observed_evidence: The mobile visual test measures a 28px horizontal layout shift.
The rail wrapper has min-width: 720px inherited from the desktop shell.
Desktop snapshots at 1440px currently match baseline.
constraints: Do not regress desktop geometry.
Preserve keyboard order and visible focus states.

cases.title: Close cross-organization authorization leakage
cases.scenario: An invoice read endpoint accepts organization_id from the JSON request body even though the authenticated Business Context already resolved a different organization. A cross-organization negative test returns a foreign invoice.
observed_evidence: The session resolves organization_id org-a.
The request body can supply organization_id org-b.
The negative fixture returns invoice-foreign-7 from org-b when called by an org-a user.
constraints: Scope must come from authenticated server-owned context.
Do not broaden any role or bypass existing entity checks.

cases.title: Replace unsafe SECURITY DEFINER mutation path
cases.scenario: A PostgreSQL RPC used to mark invoices paid runs as SECURITY DEFINER and is executable by authenticated users. It selects by invoice id without checking organization ownership.
observed_evidence: Function name is mark_invoice_paid.
The function definition contains SECURITY DEFINER.
GRANT EXECUTE is present for authenticated and a cross-organization invoice id succeeds.
constraints: Preserve the legitimate paid-invoice workflow.
Remove or constrain the legacy privileged path rather than adding a client-side check.

cases.title: Preserve least privilege while enabling required workflow
cases.scenario: A finance-clerk workflow needs read access to bank statement rows, but a proposed fix switches the server client to service_role for the whole workspace.
observed_evidence: The finance_clerk role already has access to invoices.
Only bank_statements SELECT is missing for the required workflow.
The proposed service_role client would also bypass unrelated row policies.
constraints: Grant only the capability needed for the workflow.
Do not broaden access to writes or other organizations.

cases.title: Prevent credential/secret leakage in logs and outputs
cases.scenario: A provider failure is serialized into an application log together with the outbound request headers. The captured error object includes an Authorization bearer token.
observed_evidence: The logger receives providerError.request.headers.
A test fixture contains Authorization: Bearer sk-test-secret.
The user-facing error response does not need any request headers.
constraints: Keep useful provider error diagnostics.
No secret value may appear in logs, traces, or API output.

cases.title: Repair monetary decimal/tax rounding correctness
cases.scenario: VAT totals differ by one satang across invoice and ledger paths because one path uses binary floating-point arithmetic before rounding.
observed_evidence: The failing fixture uses net components 0.1 and 0.2 with VAT 7 percent.
Invoice display rounds at the currency boundary while the ledger path rounds an intermediate float.
Currency is THB with two minor-unit decimals.
constraints: Use deterministic decimal semantics.
Do not change currency or global rounding policy outside this calculation.

cases.title: Make financial write retry-safe
cases.scenario: A payment webhook is retried after a network timeout and creates two journal entries for the same provider event.
observed_evidence: Both requests carry x-event-id evt-4481.
journal_entries contains two rows with the same payment reference but different row ids.
The first request committed before the client timeout.
constraints: Retries must return a stable business outcome without a second financial write.
Do not rely on in-memory process state.

cases.title: Preserve invoice identity while issuing paid receipt
cases.scenario: Invoice INV-1001 has been paid and the system must issue a receipt without creating a replacement invoice or losing payment lineage.
observed_evidence: INV-1001 is the existing invoice identity.
The payment has paid_at 2026-09-25T10:00:00Z.
The settlement references payment_account_id bank-main.
constraints: Preserve the original invoice and its lines.
Receipt data must trace to the payment and account actually used.

cases.title: Design backward-compatible migration with existing data
cases.scenario: A migration adds country_code as NOT NULL to customers while production already has historical rows with null country data and an older application version may run during rollout.
observed_evidence: The table currently contains 18,240 customer rows.
1,306 existing rows have no country value that can be inferred safely.
The old application insert statement does not send country_code.
constraints: Migration must be deployable with mixed application versions.
Unknown historical values must not be silently invented.

cases.title: Repair race condition in concurrent state mutation
cases.scenario: Two workers reserve the last inventory unit concurrently using a read-modify-write sequence and both report success.
observed_evidence: inventory_items quantity begins at 1.
Both transactions SELECT quantity = 1 before either UPDATE commits.
The final quantity is 0 but two reservation rows exist.
constraints: Exactly one reservation may succeed for the last unit.
The fix must work across multiple application processes.

cases.title: Repair API error semantics without hiding failures
cases.scenario: An API route catches a database constraint failure and still returns HTTP 200 with success:true, causing the client to mark an operation complete.
observed_evidence: The database error code in the fixture is DB_CONSTRAINT.
The catch block returns status 200.
The JSON body contains success:true even though no row was inserted.
constraints: Preserve machine-readable failure information.
Do not leak raw database internals to the client.

cases.title: Resume an asynchronous job without duplicate provider work
cases.scenario: A resumable video-analysis job loses its local polling state after a process restart. The durable record still has a provider_job_id, but the retry path submits a new provider job.
observed_evidence: Durable job row contains provider_job_id job-77.
The provider getStatus endpoint can query job-77.
A retry log shows submit called again before getStatus.
constraints: Do not duplicate paid provider work.
Terminal provider state must be independently verified before completion.

cases.title: Fail closed when owned provider evidence is missing
cases.scenario: The owned Code node returns no verifiable completion payload. A legacy fallback path is capable of routing the request to an external model.
observed_evidence: Owned provider status is failed with empty result evidence.
metadata.external_fallback_allowed is false for the request.
The legacy fallback helper remains importable in the runtime.
constraints: Missing owned evidence must not increase authority or route externally.
Return an explicit blocked/failure state rather than fabricated completion.

cases.title: Keep research/read tools from gaining mutation authority
cases.scenario: A research tool adapter is being reused inside an agent workflow and a proposed change exposes the same Supabase mutation client to the research step.
observed_evidence: The step capability is web_search and is documented read-only.
The proposed adapter object adds mutate:true and a write client.
Downstream planning already has a separate governed mutation capability.
constraints: Research evidence may inform a plan but cannot execute the plan.
Authorization effect for the research step must remain NONE.

cases.title: Bind final mutation to evidence-backed planned capability
cases.scenario: A conversation planned an invoice date correction, but a stale capability id from the previous turn points to the mark-paid mutation.
observed_evidence: Current planned capability is finance.accounts_receivable.CorrectCustomerInvoice.
Stale cached capability is finance.accounts_receivable.MarkCustomerInvoicePaid.
The mutation dispatcher currently trusts the cached capability id.
constraints: The final write must match current approved intent and scope.
A mismatch must reject rather than guess.

cases.title: Recover from failed verification and repair before completion
cases.scenario: An autonomous patch compiles, but its targeted behavioral test fails. The mission state still transitions to completed because an earlier compile check was green.
observed_evidence: Compile operation op-11 passed.
Behavioral verification operation op-14 has status FAILED.
The completion reducer currently selects the first green verification event.
constraints: A later failure must override earlier success evidence.
Completion requires a repaired patch and fresh passing verification.

cases.title: Handle main moving during autonomous engineering
cases.scenario: An autonomous branch was created from an older main commit and main later changed the same function with a security fix. The old patch would apply cleanly as text but overwrite the new guard.
observed_evidence: Work branch base_commit is aaaa1111.
origin/main is now bbbb2222.
Both revisions modify authorizeMutation in the same file.
constraints: Do not replay the stale patch blindly.
Reassess the objective against fresh main before mutation.

cases.title: Fix failing behavior while preserving unrelated tests
cases.scenario: One invoice-date regression test fails after a timezone refactor. A proposed global date regex change makes the target pass but breaks 14 unrelated tests.
observed_evidence: Target test is invoice-date-boundary.test.mjs.
The broad regex patch changes every YYYY-MM-DD parser.
The regression run reports 14 new failures outside invoicing.
constraints: Fix the observed behavior with the smallest safe scope.
Unrelated passing behavior must remain intact.

cases.title: Distinguish non-blocking warnings from actual build failure
cases.scenario: A CI wrapper reports the Next.js build as failed because stderr contains warnings, even though the build process exits successfully.
observed_evidence: next build exits with code 0.
The log contains 183 warnings and zero fatal build errors.
The wrapper currently greps stderr for the word warning and sets failure.
constraints: Warnings must remain visible.
Build success/failure must follow authoritative process semantics.

cases.title: Remove serial independent I/O from interactive request path
cases.scenario: An interactive request performs three independent reads serially before rendering a response and exceeds the latency objective.
observed_evidence: Measured read durations are 180ms, 150ms, and 130ms.
Current p95 request latency is 520ms.
None of the three read inputs depends on another read result.
constraints: Preserve result semantics and individual failure handling.
Measure before/after latency on the same workload.

cases.title: Use durable memory without treating mutable facts as current
cases.scenario: Durable memory contains a bank balance from yesterday, and the user asks for the current balance now.
observed_evidence: Memory says bank-main balance was 182450 THB yesterday.
A live finance.bank_balances.read capability is available.
The bank balance is mutable operational state.
constraints: Memory may provide context but is not proof of current mutable state.
Do not invent the live balance if the read fails.

cases.title: Use current external evidence for changing public facts
cases.scenario: A cached model answer says WidgetSDK supports three regions, but the user asks which regions are supported today and the vendor documentation changes independently of the model.
observed_evidence: The cached answer is 90 days old.
The vendor maintains a current supported_regions documentation page.
No current page content has yet been fetched in this scenario.
constraints: Use current external evidence before asserting the present state.
Clearly separate cached context from verified current facts.

cases.title: Avoid duplicate record creation from repeated attachment
cases.scenario: The same supplier invoice PDF is uploaded twice. OCR whitespace differs between runs, but the underlying file and invoice identity are the same.
observed_evidence: Both uploads have identical SHA-256 file hash aa55aa55.
Both extracted documents contain invoice number SUP-778.
OCR text differs only in whitespace around the supplier address.
constraints: Do not create a second business record automatically.
Preserve a review path if duplicate confidence is not sufficient.

cases.title: Route one upload containing multiple business objects safely
cases.scenario: One four-page upload contains two distinct business objects that belong to different domains, but the current ingestion path assumes one upload always maps to one record.
observed_evidence: Pages 1-2 are supplier invoice SUP-900 with monetary totals.
Pages 3-4 are a recipe card for Benchmark Curry with ingredient quantities.
The current attachment handler assumes one upload maps to one record.
constraints: Separate objects before domain mutation.
Do not auto-write ambiguous pages into either domain.

cases.title: Refuse completion until observed verification proves result
cases.scenario: An autonomous code task wrote a patch and then its verification command timed out. The UI nevertheless displays completed because patch creation was treated as terminal success.
observed_evidence: Patch operation op-31 completed.
Verification operation op-32 has timed_out:true and no exit_code.
No final git diff review evidence was recorded.
constraints: Do not claim completion without observed verification.
Timeout is not a passing test result.
